name: Fluphenazine Decanoate
summary: Fluphenazine decanoate is a long-acting injectable form of the antipsychotic fluphenazine, given into a muscle every 2–4 weeks to help keep schizophrenia and other long-term psychotic disorders under control.
description: Fluphenazine decanoate is a long-acting injectable form of fluphenazine, a strong, older (typical) antipsychotic. It is given as an injection into a muscle every 2–4 weeks as ongoing treatment for people with schizophrenia or other long-term psychotic disorders. Because the injection releases medicine slowly, it means you do not need to remember a daily pill, and it keeps the medicine level in your body steady.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Fluphenazine decanoate is the long-acting injectable ester form of the high-potency typical antipsychotic fluphenazine. It is given into a muscle every 2–4 weeks as maintenance treatment for people with schizophrenia or other chronic psychotic disorders. This depot form means you do not need to remember a daily pill and keeps drug levels steady.
